label: lowered by last reward; raised at D2 by S2, by S1-unrewarded, belief toward S2
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 45. Timing dominates (R^2 0.91): high early (~0.75-0.9), decaying steeply late in the episode, highest at D2. Beyond timing, observed-only terms give test R^2 0.50 (dev 0.49) against an all-cue ceiling of 0.56 (all observed 0.53). Main driver: the previous trial reward. A rewarded last trial lowers z by about 0.06 at every phase. Earlier rewards lower it a little more (about 0.004 per reward in trials -2..-4), so runs of rewards push it lowest. An unrewarded last trial in S1 raises it by about 0.044 at D1 and GO. Ideal-observer belief log-odds that S1 is good lower it at GO and D2 (about -0.007 per unit of log-odds), so z is higher when evidence favours S2. At D2, reaching S2 raises z by about 0.049, and choosing a1 after an unrewarded trial lowers it by about 0.045. Each added term (|belief|, D1 belief, more patterns) gained under 0.005. Finer within-decile timing alone adds only 0.07, and the largest misses are late-episode windows where the decay is steeper than the decile baseline. Model value and policy are not used. The reference scores (policy decile 0.18 vs belief 0.17; all 0.56 vs all observed 0.53) suggest dropping model outputs costs about 0.03 or less. No future variables are used.

issues: The label says z is 'raised at D2 ... by S1-unrewarded', but the term is (prev_reward==0)*(prev_state==S1)*(phase!=D2), so it covers D1 and GO only. Adding a D2-only version of the term changes test R^2 from 0.4992 to 0.5002, which is nothing. The label misstates the phase.

The claim that 'runs of rewards push it lowest' is overclaimed. The term for earlier rewards (trials -2 to -4) has a weight of -0.004, and removing it lowers test R^2 only from 0.499 to 0.496. Adding tv('reward',-2) and a prev_reward x reward(-2) interaction gives 0.501.

The D2 terms (reached S2 +0.049, a1 after an unrewarded trial -0.045) mostly capture the D2 choice x state residual from the profile (a1 S1 -0.058, a2 S2 +0.050). They are fine but describe the same thing twice.

Misses show no large systematic class. Mean error by phase is within +/-0.008, and every phase x previous-trial cell is within +/-0.031 (largest: GO after a1 S2 u, -0.031; GO after a2 S1 u, -0.026 at D2). Adding GO-specific last_is terms for these raises test R^2 only to 0.510.

The worst-fit windows are all late in the episode (t85-95), where z is over-predicted by about 0.1-0.3. The cause is decay within a decile that the timing baseline misses, not missing history. Within-decile timing terms raise test R^2 to 0.56, but that is timing, not content. Letting the reward/state/belief effects scale with ep_trial adds only about 0.018 (0.518).
